results.title: Hockey Haryana Triumphs Over Madhya Pradesh in National Championship Final
results.description: In a thrilling final at the 16th Hockey India Senior Men National Championship 2026, Hockey Haryana overcame Hockey Madhya Pradesh with a score of 2-1. The match saw Madhya Pradesh take an early lead, but Haryana's resilience shone through as they equalized and then scored the winning goal. Meanwhile, Uttar Pradesh Hockey claimed third place by defeating Hockey Punjab 3-1. This championship showcased intense competition and remarkable performances from all teams involved.
